edges.reason: Repeated ten-unit additions help convert compound money amounts. Knowing one yuan is ten jiao and composing three tens as thirty also converts directly by place value.
The criterion explicitly states one jiao is 0.1 yuan. Its money-unit conversion uses the jiao/yuan relation, even though decimals can be introduced without money.
The target interprets a one-place decimal as a count of tenths; a tenth is a unit fraction in an equal partition.
Aligning decimal tenths and interpreting their sum uses one-place decimal place-value meaning.
edges.scope: aligning decimal points when adding tenths
